name: baanrodmai
description: บ้านรอดไหม? (Baan Rod Mai?) — a Thai home-preparedness web app for any disaster: what-to-do guides for nine hazards, a home-kit checker, a family plan card, calculators for the fridge in a power cut and today's PM2.5 dust, and a 60-second hazard-hunt game, for Cloudflare Pages

scripts.deploy: node tools/build.mjs && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy public --project-name=baanrodmai
